edits.description: Restored the monochrome cursor core from QuickDraw/Classic/CrsrCore.a. The evidence records 210 matching released operations and 31 ROM-only operations, plus the original 16-byte initialization table.
Restored the fixed 512-by-342 screen geometry and 64-byte row size in drawing, hiding, shielding, and screen query routines. The later source uses screen dimension globals.

Restored the original CrsrScale and CrsrThresh acceleration rule. The ROM adds absolute coordinate changes and doubles both changes when the enabled threshold is reached. The released source replaces this with sample history and a scaling table.
Omitted the later obscure-hide-show state fix. Preserved the original hotspot bounds, cursor save area, pinning behavior, and initialization table expressed as label differences.
Retained the original author, copyright, early history, routine descriptions, and matching body and instruction comments. Omitted color cursor bodies and comments attached to later behavior.
